name: @dsh-external/dsh-ctf-observer
description: Observer sidecar for the ctf-solver preset — the bypass-supervision role from BreachWeave's Manager/Solver/Observer triad, landed on dsh. It does NOT solve or verify for you: at turn boundaries it runs deterministic checks over the recent tool stream (repeated attempts / error streaks / no-new-tool kinds / flag captured) and injects a single corrective nudge through agent.followup, guarded by a cooldown window and a same-fingerprint repeat window. Termination is externalised: when the system sees flag-shaped output it declares the challenge closable instead of leaving that judgement to the model. Injects only — never intercepts or rewrites tool calls; non-ctf-solver sessions are untouched.
author: Saker contributors
